abs_brake_fade.definition: The loss of braking power when the brakes are hot, so that the pedal goes soft.
abs_brake_fade.example: After the long descent the brakes faded and the pedal felt weak.

bicycle.definition: A machine with two wheels that you push with your feet. A good bicycle makes your legs feel like they have a strong friend.
bicycle.example: His grandfather's bicycle was heavy and rusty, and Nam loved it.
